The question explicitly asks for the shape that is physically closest to its predecessor in the trajectory — not the next shape in an incorrectly reconstructed sequence. The model treated sequence adjacency as equivalent to spatial closeness, ignoring the need to evaluate actual distances.

This reflects a failure to ground reasoning in the actual spatiotemporal structure of the video and a misunderstanding of the task objective.
